name: Community Route - Investors Join Steps

communities.blurb: For alumni investing in tech, as VCs or angels.
communities.body:
A new pilot community for Harvard alumni who invest in technology companies, or want
to learn how. To join, get into the HIT WhatsApp community first, then request the
Investors group there.

*For networking and education only. Not investment advice; HIT does not arrange,
endorse or profit from any investment.*

description: A community whose joining takes two steps, framed on its join band. Investors members apply through the shared form to get into the HIT WhatsApp community, then request the Investors group from inside WhatsApp — so the band's default line ('we'll verify your Harvard affiliation before adding you') would promise something the form does not do. The entry's own join text replaces it; AI and Founders set none and keep the default. The named pilot lead and the body's one-line networking-and-education disclaimer render further down, below the events section, and are not in this frame.
